checks.name: SSR: POST, disabled inputs, no successful form fields, accessible no-JS email fallback
Hydration: initial locks open only after React mounts, with no recoverable mismatch
Required fields: first invalid control receives focus; typing does not jump to the next error
Email: malformed addresses stay in the form, focus email, and never submit
Duplicate submit: same-tick events send once; fields and button remain locked while pending
Provider failure: retain all five fields, focus error, no auto retry; explicit retry succeeds
Timeout: abort once, preserve inputs, show uncertainty; late success does not replace the error
Acknowledgement: missing, false, or string ok cannot show success
Unmount: pending request aborts and its late resolution does not update the page
Transport: exactly one JSON POST, supplied signal, no auth or credential option, no cache or redirects
Transport failure: HTTP/provider failures, bad JSON and missing acknowledgement never retry or falsely succeed
